DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 試着された上着の着心地はいかがですか。気になるところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: How does the jacket you tried on feel? Is anything bothering you?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 立っていると合うようですが、腕を上げると肩が引っ張られます。普段と同じサイズでも、これでよいとは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 普段サイズでも腕を上げると肩が窮屈で判断できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: It seems to fit when I am standing, but it pulls at my shoulders when I raise my arms. Even though it is my usual size, I cannot decide that it is right for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that even in your usual size, the shoulders feel tight when you raise your arms, so you cannot decide. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: サイズの記号が同じでも形が違います。別の形の上着を、同じ動きで比べてみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even when the size labels are the same, the cuts differ. Would you like to compare a differently cut jacket while making the same movements?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 比べたいです。ただ大きいサイズにするだけでなく、肩が動かしやすく、袖が長すぎないものを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 単純なサイズ上げでなく動ける肩と長すぎない袖の別形を試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would. Rather than just going up a size, I would like to see one that lets my shoulders move easily without the sleeves being too long.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to try a different cut with shoulders that allow movement and sleeves that are not too long, rather than simply going up a size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の形の試着品をお持ちします。丈を直す場合は、加工の費用や条件も別に確認することになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will bring you a differently cut jacket to try on. If you have the length altered, the alteration cost and conditions will need to be checked separately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 直してから合わないと気づくのが心配です。丈直しを頼んだ後でも交換できるのか、購入前に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 丈直し後に合わない場合の交換条件を購入前に知りたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am worried about realizing it does not fit after it has been altered. Before buying, I would like to know whether it can still be exchanged after I request a length alteration.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about exchange conditions if it does not fit after a length alteration, before buying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件は加工の担当に確認します。通常の未加工品の案内だけで、加工後も同じとはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check those conditions with the alterations staff. We cannot say that the same conditions apply after alteration based only on the usual guidance for unaltered items.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今は丈を直す印も付けず、交換できると決めつけないでおきます。加工担当の説明を聞くまでは、直しを依頼しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 加工後交換を決めつけず印付けも直し依頼も担当説明まで保留すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then, for now, please do not even mark it for alteration, and I will not assume it can be exchanged. I will not request alterations until I have heard the alterations staff's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not assume an altered item can be exchanged, and will hold off on both marking and requesting alterations until the staff explain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 上着は未購入のままお預かりして、加工の説明につなぎます。別の形を試すことは続けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will hold the jacket without treating it as purchased and arrange for you to hear about alterations. Would you like to keep trying a different cut?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に別の形を試します。腕を上げたときの肩と袖を見て、直しが必要か考えてから、条件を聞いて購入を判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別形で腕上げ時の肩と袖を見て直し要否と条件の確認後に購入判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will try a different cut first. I will check the shoulders and sleeves with my arms raised, consider whether alterations are needed, and then ask about the conditions before deciding whether to buy.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the shoulders and sleeves of a different cut with your arms raised, and decide whether to buy after considering whether alterations are needed and checking the conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では別の形をご用意します。加工も購入もまだ確定していませんので、試着と説明の後にお選びください。またお声かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will get a different cut ready. Neither alterations nor a purchase have been confirmed yet, so please choose after trying it on and hearing the explanation. Let us know if you need us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品札の文字について、何かお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask something about the writing on the artwork label?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この人物画の下の名前が、描いた人の名前だと思いました。でも札にはもう一つ名前があります。どちらが作者ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人物画の二つの名前のうちどれが作者か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the name under this portrait was the name of the person who painted it. But there is another name on the label. Which is the artist?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of the two names on the portrait's label is the artist. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 上が作品名、その下の欄が作者名です。この札では、作品名に人物の呼び名が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: The top is the title of the work, and the field below it is the artist's name. On this label, the title includes the name used for the person depicted.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作品名の人が自分を描いたと勘違いしていました。自画像という意味かどうかは、題名の名前だけでは判断しない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 題名の人物を作者と思った誤解を改め名前だけで自画像と判断しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I mistakenly thought the person named in the title had painted themselves. It is better not to decide whether it is a self-portrait just from the name in the title, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your misunderstanding that the person in the title was the artist, and confirm that a name alone is not grounds to call it a self-portrait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。解説には、ここで読み取れる情報が書かれています。ほかに気になる表現はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is right. The commentary gives the information that can be understood here. Are there any other expressions you are curious about?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私はさびしそうな表情だと感じますが、解説に「作者は悲しかった」とあるわけではありません。自分の感想として話してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: さびしそうという自分の感想と作者が悲しかったという事実主張を分けたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I feel that the expression looks lonely, but the commentary does not actually say that the artist was sad. May I describe it as my own impression?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about separating your own impression that the expression looks lonely from a factual claim that the artist was sad. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の感じたこととして話すことはできます。解説にない作者の気持ちを事実として述べるのとは区別してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can speak about what you personally felt. Please distinguish that from stating as fact the artist's feelings when they are not given in the commentary.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人には「私にはさびしそうに見えた」と伝えます。写真で見せたいのですが、この作品の撮影禁止の印が当てはまりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分にはそう見えたと友人へ伝え当該作品の撮影禁止表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell my friend, 'It looked lonely to me.' I would like to show a photo, but does the no-photography symbol apply to this work?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your friend it looked that way to you, and check the no-photography sign for this particular work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この作品は撮影しないという表示です。作品札も含めた写真を撮らず、見た内容を言葉でメモする方法ならご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: It indicates that this work must not be photographed. Please do not take a photo including the artwork label either; I can explain how to make written notes about what you saw instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮影せず、作品名と作者名を別の欄にメモします。感想はさらに分け、通路を空けた場所で書いてから次の作品へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影せず作品名・作者・感想を分け通路を空けてメモすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not take photos, and will note the title and artist's name in separate fields. I will keep my impressions separate as well, and write in a place that leaves the passage clear before moving on to the next work.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not take photos, will note the title, artist and impressions separately, and keep the passage clear while writing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ほかの方が通れる場所でメモなさってください。作品札とご自身の感想を読み分けながら、どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please make your notes in a place where other people can pass. Take your time, keeping the artwork label's information distinct from your own impressions.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り場への移動について、ご案内が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need directions for getting to the boarding area?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きな荷物があるので階段を避けたいです。見えているエレベーターに乗れば、バスの乗り場まで行けると思って進んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物が大きく階段を避けたいが見えた昇降機で乗り場へ行けると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have large luggage, so I want to avoid the stairs. I was heading toward the elevator I can see, thinking it would take me to the bus boarding area.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to avoid stairs because your luggage is large, and thought the elevator you saw would lead to the boarding area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このエレベーターの表示は出口側です。乗り場へ向かう経路とは分かれています。どちらの乗り場をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: The signs for this elevator point toward the exit. That route branches away from the route to the boarding areas. Which boarding area are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乗車案内に書かれたこちらの乗り場です。エレベーターという印だけを見て、行き先の表示を読んでいませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車案内を示し昇降機記号だけ見て行先表示を読まなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one listed on my boarding information. I only looked at the elevator symbol and did not read the destination signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the boarding information and explain that you only looked at the elevator symbol without reading the destination signs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その乗り場へ階段を避けて向かう経路を、案内図で確認します。お荷物をご自身で動かせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check a route to that boarding area that avoids the stairs on the guide map. Can you move your luggage yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ゆっくりなら動かせますが、曲がる場所が多いと迷いそうです。最初の分かれ道まで、一緒に案内してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物はゆっくり動かせるが迷うため最初の分岐まで同行案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can if I go slowly, but I am likely to get lost if there are many turns. Could you come with me and guide me as far as the first junction?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you can move the luggage slowly, but may get lost, and ask to be accompanied and guided as far as the first junction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最初の分かれ道までご案内します。そこから先も表示を照らし合わせましょう。出発の時刻は案内で確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will guide you to the first junction. We should keep checking the signs against the information beyond there too. Have you checked the departure time on your information?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内の時刻は見ましたが、この経路なら必ず間に合うと判断しないで、移動にかかる見込みも乗り場の担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出発時刻を見たが必ず間に合うと判断せず移動見込みを乗り場担当に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I saw the time on the information, but rather than assume this route will definitely get me there in time, I would also like to ask the boarding-area staff how long getting there is expected to take.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you saw the departure time, but do not assume you will definitely be on time, and want to ask the boarding-area staff about the expected travel time to get there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発までの扱いは乗り場の担当へ確認します。今ここで荷物だけを置き、先に場所を見に行くのではなく、一緒に動かしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check with the boarding-area staff about the arrangements before departure. Rather than leaving just your luggage here and going ahead to find the place, let us move it along with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物を置き去りにせず持って進みます。出口用の表示に戻らないよう、分かれ道で乗り場への表示をもう一度読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を置き去りにせず分岐で出口でなく乗り場への表示を再確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take my luggage with me without leaving it unattended. At the junction, I will read the boarding-area signs again so that I do not go back toward the exit signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not leave the luggage unattended, and at the junction will recheck signs for the boarding area rather than the exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは乗車案内をお持ちのまま、分かれ道までご一緒します。間に合うことはここでは確約できません。お気をつけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then keep your boarding information with you, and I will accompany you to the junction. I cannot guarantee here that you will be on time. Please proceed carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 注文の前に確認なさりたいことがあると伺いました。どの料理でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: I heard that you would like to check something before ordering. Which dish is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この揚げ物を考えていますが、卵のアレルギーがあります。ソースをかけなければ食べられるかどうか、という聞き方だけでは足りない気がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 揚げ物を検討中だが卵アレルギーがありソース除去だけの質問では不足と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am considering this fried dish, but I have an egg allergy. I feel that just asking whether I can eat it without the sauce is not enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are considering a fried dish but have an egg allergy, and that asking only about removing the sauce is insufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ソースのほかに衣の材料なども調理担当に確認します。ほかに伝えておきたい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask the cooking staff about the coating ingredients as well as the sauce. Is there anything else you would like us to know?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 衣だけでなく、ほかの料理と器具を共用しているかも聞いてください。上に付いたものを取ればよい、とは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 衣と器具共用の確認を頼み表面の物を取ればよいとは考えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please ask not only about the coating, but also whether utensils are shared with other dishes. I do not think that simply removing something on top will be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for checks on the coating and shared utensils, and say that you do not think simply removing something from the surface is enough. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認したところ、この場では器具の共用状況について十分に答えられない部分があるとのことです。安全に食べられるとはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: After checking, we were told that there are aspects of utensil sharing here that cannot be fully answered. We cannot tell you that it is safe to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認できない点が残るなら、この料理は注文しません。「卵を抜いた」と言われた場合でも、器具のことまで解決したとは受け取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 器具の不明点が残るため注文せず卵抜きでも全問題解決と解釈しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: If there are still points that cannot be confirmed, I will not order this dish. Even if I am told the egg has been left out, I will not take that to mean the utensil issue has been resolved too.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not order because questions about utensils remain unanswered, and will not interpret 'no egg' as resolving every issue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の料理を確認することもできますが、別の名前だから条件が違うとは限りません。候補を調べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check another dish, but a different name does not necessarily mean the conditions differ. Would you like us to investigate some options?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は別の料理をそのまま注文することもやめます。まず、確認できた材料と確認できなかった器具のことを、分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別料理を安易に注文せず確認済み材料と未確認器具を分けて説明するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I will not simply order another dish either. First, please explain separately the ingredients that could be confirmed and the utensils that could not be confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a separate explanation of confirmed ingredients and unconfirmed utensils, rather than readily ordering another dish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 材料として確認した点と、器具について確認できていない点を分けてご説明します。ご注文はまだ通していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain separately what we have confirmed about the ingredients and what we have not been able to confirm about the utensils. Your order has not been sent through yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 注文前のまま止めてください。説明を聞いた上で、今日は食事を見送ります。同行者にも、自分の料理は注文していないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未注文のまま止め本日は食事を見送り同行者にも未注文と伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please leave it at the stage before ordering. Having heard the explanation, I will forgo the meal today. I will also tell my companions that I have not ordered my own food.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to keep the order unplaced, forgo today's meal, and tell your companions that you have not ordered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お客様の分の注文は入れず、食事を見送るというご希望で承りました。確認にお時間をいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood: we will not place an order for you, and you wish to forgo the meal. Thank you for giving us time to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 始める前に、持っている担当表の日付を確認しましょう。今日の掲示と一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before starting, let us check the date on the duty sheet you have. Does it match today's posted notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の紙は昨日の日付です。今日も同じ場所だと思って資材を運ぶつもりでしたが、掲示の担当が変わっているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手元は昨日の担当表で今日の掲示と違い資材運搬前だと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: My sheet is dated yesterday. I was going to carry materials, thinking I would be in the same place today, but the posted assignments seem to have changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you have yesterday's duty sheet, it differs from today's notice, and you have not yet carried the materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日の紙だけで作業場所へ入らないでください。今は確認できる場所で待ち、今日の責任者に照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not enter the work area based only on yesterday's sheet. For now, wait where we can check, and we will ask today's person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 資材はまだ動かしていません。昨日の指示を今日の許可と考えず、この紙と新しい掲示の違いを責任者に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 資材未移動で昨日指示を今日許可とせず表の相違を責任者へ確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not moved the materials yet. I will not treat yesterday's instructions as permission for today, and would like the person in charge to look at the difference between this sheet and the new notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the materials have not been moved, you will not treat yesterday's instructions as today's permission, and you want the person in charge to check the differing sheets. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい掲示では、こちらの区域が別の班の作業になっています。通り抜けるつもりでも、自分で入れると判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: On the new notice, this area is assigned to another team's work. Even if you only intend to pass through, do not decide on your own that you may enter.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 近道として通ることもやめます。私の担当範囲と、そこへ行くために使ってよい経路を、別々に説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 近道通過も避け担当範囲と許可された移動経路を分けて説明するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not use it as a shortcut either. Could you explain separately the area I am assigned to and the route I am allowed to use to get there?
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for separate explanations of your assigned area and authorized travel route, saying that you will not pass through as a shortcut either. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 責任者に担当範囲と経路の両方を示してもらいます。機械のそばにある資材でも、ご自身で取ってよいという意味にはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask the person in charge to show you both the assigned area and route. Even if materials are beside a machine, that does not mean you may take them yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 場所を教わっただけで、機械の操作や資材の移動を許可されたとは考えません。使ってよい道具と必要な保護具も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場所説明を機械操作や資材移動の許可とせず道具と保護具も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not take being told a location as permission to operate machinery or move materials. I would also like to check which tools I may use and what protective equipment is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that a location explanation is not permission to operate machinery or move materials, and that you also want to check tools and protective equipment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 装備と権限も確認します。指示がそろう前に、別の人から急いで手伝ってと言われたらどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check equipment and authorization as well. What will you do if someone else asks you to help urgently before all the instructions are ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その場の呼びかけだけで始めず、担当の責任者へ確認します。今日の担当、経路、装備と権限が不明なままなら作業を始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 急な手伝い要請だけで始めず責任者に担当・経路・装備・権限を確認するまで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not start just because someone calls out to me there; I will check with the person responsible for my assignment. I will not start work while today's assignment, route, equipment and authorization remain unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not start just because of an urgent request to help, and will wait until the person in charge confirms your assignment, route, equipment and authorization. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では作業を始めず、ここで責任者の説明を受けましょう。確認まで待機してください。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us stay here without starting work and hear the person in charge's explanation. Please wait until everything has been confirmed. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードをなくされたとのご相談ですね。どのカードか、わかる範囲を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about a lost card. Please tell me which card it is as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 普段使うキャッシュカードが見当たりません。今かばんからカードが一枚出ましたが、古い方なので、なくしたカードが見つかったとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古いカードが見つかっても普段使う紛失カードが見つかったとは言えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find the cash card I usually use. A card has just turned up in my bag, but it is the old one, so I cannot say the missing card has been found.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that finding the old card does not mean the missing card you usually use has been found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別のカードが出たのですね。発行元と、どの口座に対応するかを区別して確認しましょう。暗証番号は口頭で伝えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: So a different card has turned up. Let us distinguish the issuer and which account it corresponds to when checking. Please do not tell us your PIN aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 暗証番号は言いません。古いカードの表示は見せられますが、これを止めれば普段のカードも止まると決めつけないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 暗証番号を伝えず古いカード表示を示し停止対象を決めつけず確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not say my PIN. I can show the information on the old card, but I want to avoid assuming that blocking this one would also block my usual card.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will not reveal your PIN, will show the information on the old card, and want to check which card to block without making assumptions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の確認と、対象となる口座・カードの照合を担当が行います。紛失した方を最後に使った状況は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will verify your identity and match the relevant account and card. Do you remember the circumstances in which you last used the missing one?

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日、引き出しに使いました。場所とおよその時刻は説明できますが、その後どこでなくしたかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日の最後の利用場所と概時刻は言えるが紛失場所は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I used it to withdraw money yesterday. I can explain the location and approximate time, but I do not know where I lost it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you can give the location and approximate time of yesterday's last use, but do not know where it was lost. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後の利用と紛失した場所は分けて記録します。今はまだ停止の手続きが完了した段階ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record the last use separately from where it was lost. At this point, the blocking procedure has not yet been completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞いただけでは停止済みではないのですね。古いカードが出たので相談を取り消すことはせず、対象の確認と停止を進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明だけで停止済みとせず別カード発見で取消さず対象確認と停止を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: So simply hearing the explanation does not mean it is already blocked. I will not cancel my inquiry because the old card turned up; I would like to proceed with identifying the relevant card and blocking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that an explanation alone does not mean blocking is complete, and that you will not cancel because another card was found but want the relevant card identified and blocked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象を確かめた上で停止の手続きをご案内します。再発行の費用や時期は、その後に条件を確認してお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: After confirming which card is involved, we will explain the blocking procedure. We will check the conditions afterward and tell you the cost and timing of a replacement.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に対象カードの停止を相談し、完了したかを確認します。再発行は費用や受取り条件を聞いてから判断し、見つかった場合の連絡方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象カード停止と完了確認を先に相談し再発行条件と発見時の連絡方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: First, I will ask about blocking the relevant card and confirm whether it has been completed. I will decide about a replacement after hearing the cost and collection conditions; please also tell me how to contact you if the card is found.
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask first about blocking the relevant card and confirming completion, and request the replacement conditions and how to report finding it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは本人確認から承ります。停止の完了確認と、後で見つかった場合の案内まで順にお伝えします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-044-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will start by verifying your identity. We will explain each step, including confirmation that blocking is complete and what to do if you find it later. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: エレベーターの前でお待ちですね。どちらのホームへ行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are waiting in front of the elevator. Which platform are you going to?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この乗車案内のホームです。大きいかばんがあるので階段を避けたいのですが、エレベーターの扉が開きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きな荷物で階段を避けたいが昇降機が開かないと乗車案内を示して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The platform on this boarding information. I have a large bag, so I want to avoid the stairs, but the elevator doors will not open.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the boarding information and say that you want to avoid stairs because of your large luggage, but the elevator will not open. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここには点検中の表示があります。待てばすぐ再開するとはお伝えできません。別の経路をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a sign here saying it is being inspected. We cannot tell you it will resume soon if you wait. Would you like directions for another route?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。すぐ動くと思って待ち続けるより、階段を使わずに行ける経路があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 即再開を期待して待ち続けず階段なしの別経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. Rather than keep waiting because I think it will start moving soon, I would like to know whether there is another route without stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about an alternative route without stairs, rather than continuing to wait in the expectation of an immediate restart. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の昇降機へ向かう案を図で確認します。少し遠回りになるので、途中で休む必要もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check a route to another elevator on the map. It is a little longer; will you also need to rest along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち手をずっと握ると疲れるので、途中で立ち止まれる場所も示してください。通路の真ん中には荷物を置かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち手を握り続けると疲れるため通路を塞がず止まれる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Holding the handle all the time tires me out, so please also show me somewhere I can stop along the way. I will avoid putting my luggage in the middle of the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a place to stop without blocking the passage because holding the handle continuously is tiring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この待合の場所なら、通行部分を空けて立ち止まる案にできます。次の昇降機の稼働状況も係員へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This waiting area could be a place to stop while leaving the passage clear. I will also ask a staff member whether the next elevator is operating.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別のエレベーターも使えるか、先に確認してもらえると助かります。自分でかばんを担いで階段へ行くのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別昇降機の稼働確認を頼み荷物を担いで階段を行く案をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It would help if you checked first whether the other elevator is usable too. I will not try carrying the bag on my shoulder and taking the stairs myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the other elevator's operating status to be checked, and give up the idea of shouldering the luggage and taking the stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認までここでご案内します。出発に間に合うかも、歩く速さや状況によるため保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will assist you here until it is confirmed. I cannot guarantee whether you will be in time for departure either, since that depends on your walking speed and the circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 間に合うと決めつけず、係員の確認を待ちます。使える経路と待合を確かめたら、荷物を持ってゆっくり移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 間に合うと決めず確認後に経路と待合を使って荷物とゆっくり移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume I will be on time; I will wait for the staff to check. Once the usable route and waiting area are confirmed, I will move slowly with my luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not assume you will be on time and, after confirmation, will use the route and waiting area to move slowly with your luggage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では別の昇降機の確認から進めます。点検中の設備には進まず、こちらでお待ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will begin by checking the other elevator. Please wait here rather than proceeding toward equipment under inspection. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご相談ですね。今、受診したい症状をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first consultation here. Please tell me what symptoms you would like to have seen now.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食事の後におなかが重いように感じます。この病院は初めてなので、どこへ申し出ればよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食後に腹部が重い感じがあり初診で相談先がわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My stomach feels heavy after meals. This is my first time at this hospital, so I do not know where to ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your abdomen feels heavy after meals and that, as a first-time patient here, you do not know whom to ask. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状を整理して受診先を確認します。いつから感じていますか。はっきりしなければ、そのまま教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will organize the symptom information and check where you should be seen. Since when have you felt this? If you are unsure, please say so.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食事の後だと気づいたのは昨日です。でも、重い感じ自体はその前にもありました。昨日から始まったとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食後との関係は昨日気づいたが症状は以前にもあり開始日は断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I noticed yesterday that it was after meals. But the heavy feeling itself had happened before that too. I cannot say for certain that it began yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed the relation to meals yesterday, but the symptom had occurred earlier too, so you cannot state a definite onset date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 気づいた時期と、始まった時期が不確かなことを分けて伺います。お薬の情報など、持参されたものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will note separately when you noticed the connection and that the onset date is uncertain. Have you brought anything such as information about your medication?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お薬手帳と、資格確認のための書類を持っています。症状に合う診療科を、自分で病名を決めて選ぶのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬手帳と資格確認書類を持ち病名を自己判断せず診療科を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my medication record book and documents for eligibility verification. I would like to avoid deciding on a diagnosis myself and choosing a department on that basis; I want one suited to my symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have your medication book and eligibility-verification documents and want advice on a department without diagnosing yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 看護師として状況を伺い、担当へ相談します。ここで病名を決めるわけではありません。問診票の記入で手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: As a nurse, I will hear about your situation and consult the person in charge. We are not deciding on a diagnosis here. Do you need help filling in the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「いつから」の欄には、開始日は不明で、食後だと昨日気づいた、と書きたいです。どちらも同じ日付にまとめないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始日不明と昨日食後の関係に気づいた点を同一日付にせず問診票へ書きたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: In the 'since when' field, I would like to write that the onset date is unknown, and that I noticed yesterday it happened after meals. Please do not combine both into the same date.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to write separately on the questionnaire that the onset date is unknown and that you noticed the meal connection yesterday, rather than assigning both the same date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように区別して記載しましょう。書類の確認は受付担当へ、症状の情報は診察へつなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us record those separately as you described. We will direct the document check to the reception staff and pass the symptom information on for your medical consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類とお薬手帳を出し、症状の説明も見直します。待っている間に感じ方が変わったら、最初に言ったことと違っても職員へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類と薬手帳を出し症状を見直し待機中の変化も職員へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will provide the documents and medication record book and review my explanation of the symptoms too. If how I feel changes while waiting, I will tell the staff, even if it differs from what I first said.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will provide the documents and medication book, review your symptoms, and tell the staff about any changes while waiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 変化があればその都度お知らせください。担当へ確認して受診のご案内をします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please let us know each time there is a change. I will check with the person in charge and explain where you will be seen. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 果物の値札を比べていらっしゃいますね。どの表示が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are comparing the price labels on the fruit. Which part of the display are you wondering about?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この袋の値段だと思って見ていた数字の横に、「百グラム当たり」とあります。一袋分の支払い額とは別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 百グラム当たりの数字が一袋の支払額と違うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Next to the number I was looking at as this bag's price, it says 'per 100 grams.' Is that different from the amount I pay for one bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the figure per 100 grams differs from the amount to pay for one bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この札では、重さ当たりの比較用表示と一袋の価格を分けています。どれくらいの量をお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this label, the price-by-weight comparison and the price for one bag are shown separately. How much would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人で食べるので、少ない量がほしいです。重さ当たりが安くても、大袋を全部使い切れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人用少量を希望し単位価格が安くても大袋を使い切れないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will eat it on my own, so I want a small quantity. Even if the price per weight is lower, I will not necessarily be able to finish a large bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want a small amount for one person and may not finish a large bag even if the unit price is lower. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小袋の価格はこちらです。袋に入った個数と、値札の対象商品が一致するかも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The price of the small bag is here. Let us also check whether the number of pieces in the bag matches the product the price label refers to.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隣には同じ果物のばら売りもあるので、袋と一個の札を混ぜないようにしたいです。こちらの小袋に対応する札を指してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ばら売りの一個札と混同せず小袋に対応する値札を示すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The same fruit is also sold individually next to it, so I want to avoid confusing the bag label with the per-piece label. Could you point to the label that corresponds to this small bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to point out the label for the small bag so that you do not confuse it with the per-piece label for loose fruit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この品名と個数が合う札です。今お持ちの小袋なら、一袋の合計表示はこちらになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is this label whose product name and number of pieces match. For the small bag you are holding, this is the total for one bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この一袋分の税込み表示で比べます。二袋買った場合の比較ではなく、今日持ち帰る一袋の額を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日買う一袋の税込み総額で比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will compare using this tax-inclusive price for one bag. I do not want a comparison for buying two bags; I want to see the amount for the one bag I will take home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to compare the total tax-inclusive price for the one bag you are buying today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一袋だけのご購入ですね。レジでも袋の商品として表示されているかご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You will buy just one bag, then. You can also check at the register that it is displayed as the bagged product.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この小袋を一つにします。百グラムの比較数字を一袋の値段と思わず、レジで品名と一袋の額を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小袋一つを選び単位比較数字でなくレジの袋品名と額を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take one of these small bags. I will not mistake the comparison figure per 100 grams for the price of one bag, and will check the product name and one-bag amount at the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one small bag and say that you will check the bagged product name and amount at the register, rather than the unit comparison figure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 小袋一つで承りました。お会計前の表示でもご確認ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: One small bag, understood. Please also check the display before payment. Thank you very much.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をお会計します。持ち帰り用の袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will ring up these items. Do you have a bag to take them home in?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい袋を持っていますが、飲み物を追加したので全部は入らなさそうです。まだ会計を確定しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋が小さく追加飲料で入りきらないため会計確定を待ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a small bag, but I added drinks, so it does not look as though everything will fit. Please do not finalize the sale yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the cashier to wait before finalizing because your own bag is small and will not fit the added drinks as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加の袋を使うか、商品を選び直すか、どちらになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like to use an extra bag or change your selection of items?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は必要な食品だけにして、追加した飲み物二本は戻したいです。袋を増やして全部運ぶのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要食品だけ残し追加飲料二本を外して袋を増やさないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Today I will only take the food I need and would like to put back the two drinks I added. I will not add bags to carry everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to keep only the necessary food, remove the two added drinks, and not add a bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲み物二本を外します。残りの商品について、温めるご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will remove the two drinks. Would you like any of the remaining products heated?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 温めなくて大丈夫です。持参袋に残りが入るかを見てから詰めます。外した飲み物が明細に残っていないかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 温め不要で袋容量と明細から飲料が外れたことを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is no need to heat anything. I will check whether the remaining items fit in the bag I brought before packing them. I also want to make sure the removed drinks are not still on the itemized list.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that no heating is needed and that you want to check bag capacity and that the drinks have been removed from the itemized list. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確定前の明細から二本を外した内容をご覧ください。お支払いは何を使われますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at the details showing that the two drinks have been removed from the list before finalizing. What will you use to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金を使うつもりですが、手元の額で足りるか先に合計を見ます。足りないまま硬貨を入れ始めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金予定だが硬貨投入前に手持ちが合計に足りるか確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I intend to pay cash, but I will look at the total first to see whether I have enough with me. I will avoid starting to insert coins when I do not have enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to pay cash but will check whether you have enough for the total before inserting coins. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが今の合計です。お金を入れる前に、ご自身の手持ちと照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the current total. Before putting money in, please compare it with the amount you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残った商品の品名と合計を確認しました。この内容なら現金で払います。レシートも受け取って、袋と商品を忘れずに持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残品の品名と合計確認後その内容で現金払いしレシートと袋も持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the names of the remaining items and the total. I will pay cash for these items. I will take the receipt too and make sure not to leave my bag or purchases behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after checking the remaining item names and total, you will pay cash for those items and take the receipt and bag as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではこの内容で現金のお会計に進みます。追加の二本は含めていません。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will proceed with cash payment for these items. The two added drinks are not included. Thank you very much.
